Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gourmet Poultry Pilafs are meals made by [[Cooking]] a [[Raw Whole Bird]], [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], and a [[Bird Egg]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they restore a few [[Heart]]s to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]]. Not only are they made with high-quality poultry, but they also flood one's mouth with flavor with every bite. Additional ingredients can be added to Gourmet Poultry Pilaf, which can result in one of the following variations: * '''Chilly Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold ingredients. When they are eaten, Link gains one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric ingredients. Eating them will grant Link on level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring ingredients. Consuming these will completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. If eaten, they will refill a part of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty ingredients. If they are eaten, Link's movement speed will receive a short boost. * '''Hearty Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. Eating these Pilafs will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty ingredients. Link gains an increase to the power of his attacks when he eats these. * '''Sneaky Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky ingredients. If eaten, Link will receive a temporary boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Gourmet Poultry Pilaf''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Gourmet Poultry Pilaf}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Made with the highest-quality poultry, every bite of this pilaf floods your mouth with flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough ingredients. When eaten, they increase Link's defense. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Gourmet Poultry Pilaf is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[A Bird in the Hand]]". It is made using four [[Raw Whole Bird]]s, four [[Tabantha Wheat]], four [[Bird Egg]]s, and four [[Goat Butter]]s. However, it can be lowered to three of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will start with four extra [[Heart]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Gourmet Poultry Pilaf Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Gourmet Poultry Pilaf ==See Also== {{See Also| * Curry Pilaf * Food * Meal * Poultry Pilaf * Prime Poultry Pilaf }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
